children: Vivid Seats Named Official Fan Experience Partner, Bringing Rams Fans Exclusive Access to the Action at SoFi Stadium

, a leading marketplace that utilizes its technology platform to connect millions of buyers with thousands of ticket sellers across hundreds of thousands of events each year, today announced a multi-year partnership with the Los Angeles Rams, becoming the team’s Official Fan Experience Partner and giving fans new ways to get closer to all the action at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, CA.

Beginning this football season, Vivid Seats will offer exclusive Rams Fan Experience Packages for home games, unlocking memorable gameday moments that go beyond the seat. Depending on the package of their choice, fans can experience much more than just the game, including pregame sideline access during player warmups, or postgame field access, among other perks.

: Get closer to the action before kickoff with a game ticket in the selected zone and exclusive sideline access beginning two hours before the game. Fans can watch Rams players take the field, warm up and prepare for kickoff from an unforgettable vantage point.

: Keep gameday going after the final whistle with exclusive access to the field. Fans can step onto the turf, take in SoFi Stadium from field level and experience the setting where the action just unfolded.

“We’re thrilled to partner with the Los Angeles Rams,” said Geoff Lester, Chief Commercial Officer at Vivid Seats. “We’re always looking for new ways to make live events more rewarding and memorable for fans. Through this partnership, we’re pairing the passion of Rams fans with exclusive access and experiences at SoFi Stadium to make gameday even more memorable.”

“We’re always looking for ways to create deeper, more memorable connections with our fans, and Vivid Seats shares that commitment to elevating the gameday experience,” said Jennifer Prince, Chief Commercial Officer, Los Angeles Rams. “This partnership gives Rams fans new opportunities to get closer to the action and experience gameday at SoFi Stadium in ways that extend well beyond their seats.”

As part of the partnership, Vivid Seats will also serve as the exclusive presenting sponsor of the Rams’ VIP Pregame Sideline Experience. The partnership further expands Vivid Seats’ growing portfolio of strategic sports partnerships, which includes the Los Angeles Chargers, Indianapolis Colts, Chicago Bears and San Francisco 49ers.

The Los Angeles Rams – Los Angeles’ original professional sports team and Super Bowl LVI Champions – stand as one of the oldest franchises in the National Football League and since its founding in 1937, have garnered four World Championships and sent 30 of its members to the Pro Football Hall of Fame. As a professional sports team, the organization is committed to be a valuable civic partner and serving the greater Los Angeles area 365 days a year. The Rams play their home games at SoFi Stadium, which is located at Hollywood Park, a 298-acre sports and entertainment destination owned, being developed and operated by Los Angeles Rams owner/chairman E. Stanley Kroenke in Inglewood, Calif.
